fit: Unchanged 20%-70% imposed amplitude on first loading half, ordinary least squares with intercept

regions.reference: Bond reference midpoint, determined from geometry before reading utilization
regions.notch_tip: Distance to reference front line x=-100um,z=0 across full y thickness <=delta
regions.other_surface: Remaining bonds with midpoint within delta of any x/y/z exterior plane
regions.on_projected_plane: Endpoints on opposite sides of z=0; z=0 assigned upper side
regions.near_field_support: Node neighbor count and frozen weighted volume m normalized by intact full-neighborhood median

notch_dominance_gate.first_or_earliest_coherent: First event near tip OR earliest face-connected cluster of >=10 failed-bond midpoint voxels at dx resolution intersects initial tip strip |x+100um|<=dx and |z|<=delta/2
notch_dominance_gate.crack_band_fraction: >=70% of new broken bonds before/at actual stress peak must lie in declared target band
notch_dominance_gate.grip_fraction: <=20% of new broken bonds before/at peak in grip transition region
notch_dominance_gate.area: Contiguous connected crossing-bond loss front from original notch tip in y strips, single projected face; no count*dx^2; disconnected/competing fronts invalidate material area
notch_dominance_gate.independent_energy: max absolute residual / full-process max absolute cumulative boundary work <=5%
notch_dominance_gate.result: All geometry gates required for single-crack interpretation; otherwise GC_UNAVAILABLE

shear_gates.periodic_neighbors: Exact match to independently enumerated integer-offset lattice graph, no duplicate/self bonds, correct reference minimum images; 2delta<cell lengths
shear_gates.uniformity: Report local F dispersion, no outcome-selected ROI

limitations: Baseline only initial/peak/end full states for M2 and initial/first-break/peak/end for M5. No invented intermediate fields or pre-first-break coordinates; every-step global scalars and exact native break times do exist.
